title: Rename Coord to Coordinate
description: Rename the domain type `Coord` to `Coordinate` across all semio language implementations (py, ts, rs, cs, go, rb, graphql, jsonschema, openapi, xmi, liveblocks, assets, AGENTS.md). The AGENTS.md spec already standardizes on `Coordinate` (section "Coordinate" at line 2312, class `Coordinate` at line 701), but many source files still use the abbreviation `Coord`. Apply word-boundary aware substitution covering: Coord->Coordinate, Coords->Coordinates, coord->coordinate, coords->coordinates. Preserve already-correct `Coordinate` tokens. Do not touch ticket folders, session logs, cursor plans, or other historical artifacts. Run test suites per implementation to confirm.
summary:
Renamed `Coord`/`coord` → `Coordinate`/`coordinate` across the semio source tree using a scoped regex rewrite (`Coord(?!i)` / `coord(?!i)` preserves already-correct `Coordinate*` tokens).

Scope: limited to `semio/` (excluded `.repo/`, storybook-static, htmlcov, .vscode-test, node_modules, target, __pycache__, dist, build, elements/, coda/, and the ticket folder itself). The rename touched 27 files with 743 replacements, covering Python, TypeScript/JS, Rust, Go, C#, GraphQL, JSON schema, OpenAPI, XMI, Liveblocks, Mermaid, and asset fixtures.

Cascade updates beyond the textual rename:
- `semio/assets/semio/nakagin-capsule-tower.paste.with-coord.design.diff.semio.json` renamed to `...with-coordinate...` with references updated in `semio/go/main_test.go`, `semio/net/Semio.Tests/Tests.cs`, `semio/assets/index.ts`, and `semio/assets/semio/copy-paste.cases.semio.json`.
- `semio/go/main.go`: Go hash tag strings in `w.writeString("Coord")` / `w.writeString("CoordDiff")` become `"Coordinate"` / `"CoordinateDiff"` — this deliberately changes the canonical kit hash.
- `semio/assets/semio/hash.cases.semio.json`: updated `kitHash.expected` from `5d10956987f80d1935045b3d24a37121d189712c1451bee02066a686c4e3e2d7` to the new Go-produced `8b77d0ccf79c61e6454df276c3d29c0c8f40a84e49a3e2e2179f54d1455b99ee` so the reference hash matches the renamed tag.
- `semio/rs/Cargo.toml`: fixed unrelated pre-existing broken `path = "lib.rs"` to `path = "src/lib.rs"` so the Rust crate can be built (per CLAUDE.md "fix unrelated problems").

Verification:
- Rust: 77/77 tests pass against the renamed crate (built with isolated `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` to avoid locked-linker issues).
- Go: `go build ./...` succeeds. Test run shows pre-existing failures (TestFlatten slanted/twisted/dancing, TestValidation, TestFilterKit, TestMetaShallow). Confirmed as pre-existing by running the same filters in a sparse-checkout worktree at pre-rename commit `63eec0e86` — identical failures there. Only `TestHashKit` changed meaningfully, and the expected value in `hash.cases.semio.json` was updated to reflect the rename.
- TS/JS (vitest with `SEMIO_JS_RUN_EMBEDDED_TESTS=1`): 211/228 pass. 17 failures are pre-existing: `hashKit` JS vs Go divergence (JS produces `8e0e9fc3...` while Go produces `8b77d0cc...` — the rename was applied consistently to both, so the divergence is in the hash implementations themselves); `ExportDesignRepresentation` fails because of unrelated `sqlrepresentation` package resolution (artifact of a previous `Model`→`Representation` rename, not this ticket); CopyAndPaste and FindReplaceableTypesInDesigns failures are unrelated logic mismatches.
- .NET: `Semio.csproj` does not compile due to pre-existing errors from a prior `Model`→`Representation` rename that clobbered external references (`SharpGLTF.Schema2.ModelRoot` → non-existent `RepresentationRoot`; `System.ComponentModel` → non-existent `System.ComponentRepresentation`). Cannot exercise the .NET hash test in this ticket; `expectedNet48` left untouched. That fix belongs in a separate ticket.

The rename is internally consistent. Open follow-ups (separate tickets): unify JS and Go kit hash implementations; repair the `Model`→`Representation` over-rewrite in `Semio/Semio.cs` and `Resources.Designer.cs`; resolve the `sqlrepresentation` package artifact.
